content:
**Bigfoot** is a Cryptid that appears in *Fallout 76*.

Bigfoot, or Sasquatch, is a Cryptid native to Appalachia. The presence of Bigfoot was suspected prior to the Great War, with the April edition of Backwoodsman proclaimed a man was "Hardy as a sasquatch" after 36 days of eating vampire bats. [1] In the radio play Rip Daring and the Cryptid Hunt, the titular Rip Daring claims himself to be the reason "Bigfoot hides in the hills!", and that he was expelled by the Council due to hunting bigfoot. [2] 

After the Great War, Bigfoot came to be worshipped by individuals alongside his fellow squatches Sheepsquatch and Veggie Man. Worshippers construct totems in reverence of the creatures, a practice observed and decried by The Enlightened, who believe the squatches to be simple animals. [3] 

Bigfoot appears in *Fallout 76*.

Bigfoot is a reference to the mythological creature of the same name.
